# Itoby Infotech Pvt Ltd (IIPL)

> Itoby Infotech Pvt Ltd (IIPL) is a premier global digital agency, custom software development company, and SaaS software lab headquartered in Noida, India, serving clients across the US, Canada, Australia, and India.

## Executive Overview
Itoby Infotech Pvt Ltd (IIPL) specializes in bespoke enterprise software engineering, high-converting web design, cross-platform mobile apps (iOS & Android), data-driven digital marketing, and Microsoft 365 cloud migrations. Additionally, IIPL develops and operates 5 proprietary SaaS and AI platforms.

## Core Digital Services
- [Web Design & Development](https://itobyinfotech.com/services/web-design): High-performance Next.js, React, and 3D WebGL websites engineered for speed and 100/100 Core Web Vitals.
- [Mobile App Development](https://itobyinfotech.com/services/mobile-app): Native iOS, Android, and cross-platform React Native & Flutter applications.
- [Digital Marketing & SEO](https://itobyinfotech.com/services/digital-marketing): Data-driven PPC, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and conversion rate optimization.
- [Custom Software Solutions](https://itobyinfotech.com/services/software-solutions): Enterprise SaaS, microservices, API integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
- [Microsoft 365 Services](https://itobyinfotech.com/services/microsoft-365): Cloud migration, Azure AD identity security, and Teams collaboration setup.

## Proprietary IIPL SaaS & AI Product Suite
- [IIPL Lead](https://lead.itobyinfotech.com): AI-powered B2B lead generation, Google Maps lead scraper, 15-second AI web health auditor, and automated cold email outreach outbox.
- [IIPL Renting](https://rent.itobyinfotech.com): Commercial office leasing & tenant CRM software, digital agreement generator, rent collection, and fleet occupancy analytics.
- [IIPL Billing](https://billing.itobyinfotech.com): Enterprise GST billing, automated client ledgers, recurring retainer subscriptions, and E-Way bill API sync.
- [IIPL Cashmemo](https://cashmemo.itobyinfotech.com): Instant retail cash receipt and cash memo builder with WhatsApp PDF sharing and thermal printer support.
- [IIPL Calling](https://royalblue-ant-234341.hostingersite.com/): Autonomous conversational AI voice agents for restaurant table reservations, insurance policy renewal reminders, and sales cold calling.
